relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, we found that the MORGABA cKO phenotype in the mPFC suppressed the activation of mPFC–PAG projections under exposure to acute restraint stress.

key_findings: Deletion of MORs in mPFC, specifically on GABAergic (not glutamatergic) neurons, attenuated acute restraint stress-induced analgesia in male mice.
Restraint stress activated mPFC-PAG projections, whose chemogenetic inhibition reduced SIA; this activation depended on mPFC MORGABA, consistent with a disinhibition mechanism.
